function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在撲克牌中獲得一副葫蘆的機率是多少？" which means "What is the probability of getting a full house in a poker hand?" They want the probability. We can compute using combinatorics: For standard 52-card deck, 5-card hand. Probability of full house: choose rank for triple (13 ways), choose 3 cards from 4 suits of that rank (C(4,3)=4). Choose rank for pair from remaining 12 ranks (12 ways), choose 2 cards from 4 suits of that rank (C(4,2)=6). So total favorable hands: 13*4 * 12*6 = 3744. Total possible 5-card hands: C(52,5) = 2,598,960. Probability = 3744 / 2598960 ≈ 0.001440576. Usually expressed as about 0.1441% or 1 in 693. So answer: 3744/2598960 ≈ 0.00144.
